new-icons-on-panel.description: Show new icons on the panel
new-icons-on-panel.tooltip: When off, icons you haven't placed yet go behind the arrow (like Windows). Right-click the arrow to choose which icons are shown on the panel.

columns.description: Icons per row in the popup

panel-columns.description: Icons per row on a vertical panel
panel-columns.tooltip: Automatic shows 2 per row on panels 45 pixels or wider, otherwise 1. Icons are made smaller if needed so they fit across the panel.
